pricing.credits_what_title: What you can do with your credits
pricing.faq_q1: What is the difference between a static QR and a dynamic QR?
pricing.faq_a1: A static QR encodes data directly: it cannot be changed after creation. A dynamic QR points to an editable redirect URL at any time — without reprinting the QR. Ideal for a restaurant menu, a promo or a product page.
pricing.faq_q2: Can I use the platform without creating an account?
pricing.faq_a2: Yes! With the Pay-as-you-go plan, you pay for each service individually (SVG, PDF, logo, dynamic QR) with no registration.
pricing.faq_q3: Is ticketing available on the free plan?
pricing.faq_a3: No. QR ticketing (registration + unique ticket per attendee) is available from the Pro plan at 19,900 FCFA/month.
pricing.faq_q4: How does Mobile Money QR payment work?
pricing.faq_a4: You create a payment QR, your customers scan and pay via Wave, Orange Money or MTN MoMo. Available from the Pro plan.
pricing.faq_q5: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
pricing.faq_a5: Yes, no commitment. You manage your subscription from your profile, no hidden fees.
pricing.faq_q6: What happens if I downgrade my plan?
pricing.faq_a6: Your dynamic QRs switch to read-only mode. Your data is kept for 30 days.
pricing.faq_a7: PNG (free), vector SVG and printable PDF (available from the Essential plan or as a one-time purchase). SVG is ideal for large-format printing, PDF for flyers and posters.
pricing.faq_q8: Can I add my logo to the QR code?
pricing.faq_a8: Yes, from the Essential plan. You can center your logo, choose from 14 frame styles and customize the colors and module shapes for a QR code in your brand image.
pricing.faq_a9: Static QRs encode data directly: they work even without internet. Dynamic QRs require a connection for the redirect, but the scan itself works anywhere.
pricing.faq_q10: Which Mobile Money operators are supported?
pricing.faq_a10: Wave, Orange Money (Côte d'Ivoire, Senegal, Mali…), MTN Mobile Money and Moov Money. Visa/Mastercard bank cards are also accepted for subscriptions.
pricing.faq_a11: You create an event, set the capacity and seats. Each registrant receives a unique QR ticket. At entry, just scan — the system instantly validates or rejects and prevents duplicates.
pricing.faq_q12: Do my QR codes have an expiration date?
pricing.faq_a12: Static QRs never expire. Dynamic QRs stay active as long as your subscription is valid. On a downgrade, they switch to read-only (not expired) for 30 days.
pricing.faq_a13: The platform is a Progressive Web App (PWA): add it to your home screen from your mobile browser for quick access, no app store needed. It also works perfectly on desktop.
pricing.faq_q14: Is the REST API available for all plans?
pricing.faq_a14: REST API access is reserved for the Business plan. It enables bulk generation (up to 1,000 QRs), integration into your business tools and retrieval of scan statistics via secure endpoints.
pricing.faq_a15: Yes. The platform uses a Supabase + Vercel infrastructure with SSL encryption, Row Level Security (RLS) and servers hosted in Europe. Your data and your customers' data is never sold.
